system.description: The fourth arm of the Unconquered Sun clutches a laurel branch, symbolizing peace and prosperity. It is the prize for which the other arms of the Unconquered Sun strive. Mindful of this lesson, the martial artist imposes peace through any means necessary. Concentrating for a moment and then launching a precise, forceful strike to his opponent's solar plexus, the character disrupts Essence flow through that key meridian. He launches a Martial Arts attack at his full dice pool. Should it inflict any damage, the target suffers a Crippling effect that forces him to add a surcharge equal to his own current wound penalty to the cost of any Essence expenditures he makes for the remainder of the scene.
system.source: Glories of the Most High: Unconquered Sun
